---
title: Ground meat frittata
id: MAR-0037
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 25
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 200 g ground beef
- 5 eggs
- 1 shallot
- 40 g butter
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Peel the shallot, cut it into small cubes and sauté it until soft in 20 g of butter.
2. Add the meat, stir and cook for about 10 minutes.
3. Remove from heat and let cool.
4. Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat them with a fork, then add the meat, salt and mix.
5. Heat the remaining butter and pour in the egg and meat mixture.
6. Cook the frittata on both sides, turning it halfway through cooking with a lid.
